title: Traversal
definition: Visiting every element in an array exactly once, usually via a `for` loop, `forEach`, or `map`. Time complexity is strictly O(N).
simpleExplanation: Walking down the row of lockers and looking inside every single one.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Array Traversal.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Array Traversal to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Array Traversal (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Array Traversal for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Array Traversal in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
